description: Add real-time collaboration features to Knowledge Plaza (subscribe/notify, locking, change feed)
steps: In src/nexus/knowledge/plaza.py, add PageChangeEvent dataclass with fields: page_id, company_id, change_type (str: 'created'|'updated'|'deleted'), agent_id, timestamp, metadata dict
Add _subscribers dict[uuid.UUID, list[Callable]] to KnowledgePlaza.__init__ to track per-company subscriber callbacks
Add subscribe(company_id, callback) method that registers a callback for page change events in a company, returns a subscription_id
Add notify_subscribers(page_id, company_id, change_type, agent_id) async method that calls all registered callbacks for the company with a PageChangeEvent
Add get_recent_changes(company_id, since_timestamp, limit=50) async method that returns recent PageChangeEvents (stored in an internal deque/list)
Add lock_page(page_id, agent_id, duration_seconds=300) method that acquires a page lock with auto-expiry timestamp
Add unlock_page(page_id, agent_id) method that releases lock only if held by the same agent
Add is_page_locked(page_id) method that checks lock status respecting expiry
Wire notify_subscribers into publish_page and update_page methods

Create tests/test_knowledge_plaza_collab.py with tests covering: subscribe/notify flow, multiple subscribers, unsubscribe, get_recent_changes with timestamp filtering, lock_page/unlock_page, lock expiry, lock by wrong agent rejected, PageChangeEvent fields
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/test_knowledge_plaza_collab.py passes all new tests
notify_subscribers() delivers PageChangeEvent to all registered callbacks
get_recent_changes() returns events since given timestamp with limit
Existing KnowledgePlaza methods (publish_page, update_page, search_pages) still work unchanged
